def _guard(role, m3, catalogue_bytes):
    o = _new_base(m3, catalogue_bytes)
    owner, lease, selection = o.context()
    producer = o.code('guard_producer', m3, 3, 4)
    rows = {r['role']: r for r in o.value('selection')['rows']}
    row = rows[role]
    body = _ow_json(_fixed('predecessor_' + role)[1])
    inputs = []
    if role == 'profile':
        body['preparation_limitations'][0] += ' Synthetic metadata descriptor only; unissued.'
    else:
        profile = _ow_json(_fixed('predecessor_profile')[1])
        profile['preparation_limitations'][0] += ' Synthetic metadata descriptor only; unissued.'
        pp = o.add_raw('guard_profile', _ow_wire(profile), rows['profile']['canonical_path'])
        inputs.append(pp)
        evidence = o.add_raw('guard_static_evidence', b'synthetic recorded input bytes', _OW_HOME + '\\guard_evidence.data')
        inputs.append(evidence)
        for key in body:
            if key.endswith('_sha256'):
                body[key] = pp['sha256'] if key == 'profile_sha256' else evidence['sha256']
    draft = o.add_raw('guard_draft', _ow_wire(body), row['draft_path'])
    diff = o.add_raw('guard_diff', b'synthetic complete guard diff', _OW_HOME + '\\guard_' + role + '.diff')
    receipt_path = _OW_HOME + '\\guard_' + role + '_author.json'
    inputs = sorted(inputs, key=lambda p: p['path'])
    purpose = o.add('guard_purpose', dict(schema_version=2, record_type='Root_owner_v2_guard_profile_static_metadata_producer_purpose', author='/root', Root_thread=o.value('owner')['Root_thread'], created_utc=_ow_time(14), role=role, current_owner_scope=o.scope, inputs=inputs, output_paths=sorted([draft['path'], diff['path'], receipt_path]), source_only=True))
    support = o.support('guard_purpose_review', purpose, 14, 15, [purpose] + inputs)
    receipt = o.add('guard_author', dict(schema_version=2, record_type='Root_owner_v2_guard_profile_static_metadata_output_author_receipt', author='/root', Root_thread=o.value('owner')['Root_thread'], created_utc=_ow_time(16), role=role, current_owner_scope=o.scope, new_canonical_lease=lease['canonical'], Root_future_path_selection=selection['selection'], producer_support=producer, producer_purpose=purpose, draft=draft, predecessor=row['predecessor'], diff=diff, actual_physical_Source_editor='/root', retained_semantic_Source_author=row['retained_semantic_Source_author'], inputs=inputs, whole_predecessor_bytes=base64.b64encode(_fixed('predecessor_' + role)[1]).decode(), body_schema='profile_body57' if role == 'profile' else 'static_body20', source_only=True, target_execution=False, canonical_publication=False, operational_authority=False, actual_guard_producer_issued=False), receipt_path)
    o.add('wrapper', dict(schema_version=2, record_type='Root_owner_v2_guard_profile_static_metadata_author_packet', Root_thread=o.value('owner')['Root_thread'], role=role, current_owner_support=owner, new_lease_support=lease, Root_future_path_selection_support=selection, producer_support=producer, producer_purpose_support=support, author_receipt=receipt, draft=draft, predecessor=row['predecessor'], inputs=inputs, source_only=True))
    o.b['packet'] = o.row('wrapper')['body']
    o.b['mutable'] = sorted(o.mutable)
    o.b['now_utc'] = _ow_time(20)
    return copy.deepcopy(o.b)

def proof(self, name, subjects, at, adopt, extra=None, context=True):
        subjects = list({p['path']:copy.deepcopy(p) for p in subjects}.values())
        common = dict(schema_version=2,record_type='synthetic_new_I13_general_Source_proof',reviewer='/root/i13_outer_independent_review',created_utc=_ow_time(at),verdict='PASS_SOURCE_SYNTHETIC_RECORDED_METADATA_ONLY',checks_passed=1,checks_failed=0,subjects=subjects,target_execution=False,operational_authority=False,native_Parser_executed=False)
        if extra:common.update(copy.deepcopy(extra))
        full = copy.deepcopy(common);full['checks'] = [dict(name='whole_bytes_and_declared_metadata',passed=True,evidence='synthetic metadata only; complete subjects retained above')]
        fp = self.add(name+'_full',full)
        cap = copy.deepcopy(common);cap['full_proof'] = fp;cp = self.add(name+'_capsule',cap)
        required = subjects+[cp,fp]+([self.scope,self.selection] if context and self.scope and self.selection else [])
        required = list({p['path']:copy.deepcopy(p) for p in required}.values())
        ad = dict(schema_version=2,record_type='synthetic_new_I13_Root_Source_adoption',author='/root',created_utc=_ow_time(adopt),verdict='ACCEPT_SOURCE_SYNTHETIC_RECORDED_METADATA_ONLY',subjects=required,different_review=cp,full_proof=fp,target_execution=False,operational_authority=False,native_Parser_executed=False)
        if extra:ad.update(copy.deepcopy(extra))
        ap = self.add(name+'_adoption',ad)
        return cp,ap
